fieldValues.title: Separating what the meeting did from context can be checked, and held on a real meeting
fieldValues.summary: With a context field, an informed-by relation and three declared checks, a real meeting re-minuted in a governance master gave 18 minutes, 14 with context and 23 links to the records it came from, and none named an outside record in what the meeting did.
evidence: srs-lab minutes/ package 0.4 and RULES.md; rules run 2026-11-27
No minute of type decision was written, against three in the earlier run; context came only from standing records, not the earlier meeting
fieldValues.body: The checks are declared in the profile note and stated in the brief. Whether the conservatism about decisions is the rule working or the model retreating needs a person's reading.
